senses.gloss: दैव name of a system of grammar or a work on grammar the peculi- arity of which is the omission of the एकशेष topic; cf. अनेकशेषं दैवं स्यात्
दैवादिक a root belonging to the fourth conjugation of roots.( दिवा- दिगण ); cf.जसु ताडेन इति चुरादौ पठ्यते तस्येदं ग्रहणं, न देवादिकस्य, Kas. on P. II 3.56.
